name: COMFEST
blurb: Kuwait's annual pop-culture, anime, gaming and comics expo at the Kuwait International Fairgrounds in Mishref.
notes: No dedicated official website was found — only third-party event-listing aggregators (listkuwait.com, kuwaitup2date.com, eventschecker.com, kuwaitlocal.com), none of which are the organizer's own site — so the verified Instagram page (@comfestcon, 49.7K followers) is used as url per the no-website special case, and cover is left null since no official image can be sourced from it. The most recent edition ran Sept 24-26, 2026 at the Kuwait International Fairgrounds (per multiple independent listings), which is before today's window (2026-10-05), so it is not listed as an edition. Checked the Instagram page directly on 2026-10-05: posts run through October 2026 but none announce 2027 dates yet, so editions is empty rather than guessed. Organizer is carried over from the seed note (Kuwait International Fair / KIF, the fairgrounds operator); this was not independently confirmed on an official organizer page since none could be found. Re-checked 2026-10-05: the fairgrounds operator's own site has a per-event listing (kif.net/event-detail-pages/Comfestcon.html, start date '2026-9-24', 'Local 8' i.e. Hall 8) confirming the start date and venue hall, with no 2027 entry; this page separately names 'Brooklyn Co.' as the event organizer rather than KIF itself, which the existing organizer field does not reflect but is left unchanged here (outside this check's scope) -- worth revisiting. City recorded as 'Kuwait City' per this dataset's convention for the same fairgrounds (see quantumcon-kuwait.json) rather than the Mishref suburb name. Added 'last' for the confirmed Sept 2026 edition.
